title: Octopuses have three hearts, and that's not even the weird part

scenes.text: This animal has three hearts, blue blood, and it can taste with its arms.
Meet the octopus, the closest thing to an alien living on Earth.
Two of its hearts pump blood through the gills. The third pumps it around the body.
And here's the twist: that third heart stops beating when it swims.
That's why octopuses prefer crawling. Swimming wears them out fast.
Their blood is blue because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron like ours.
Most of their neurons aren't even in their head. They're spread through all eight arms.
So each arm can explore, touch and taste on its own.
They can change colour in a fraction of a second, even though they're colour blind.
So next time someone says aliens aren't real, remember this animal has three hearts.

description: Three hearts, blue blood and arms that think for themselves: the octopus is the strangest animal in the sea.
